candidate_contract.actual_plant_vehicle: nominal vehicle with first three main-engine max_thrust_n multiplied by actual_thrust_factor; only this vehicle advances the plant
candidate_contract.limits: low-level state, mass, inertia and aerodynamic feedback remains idealized as in step 1; this is not a realistic sensor-estimation experiment
candidate_contract.observed_feedback: same state feedback as step 1; actual kinematics and actuator states are available, actual max_thrust_n is withheld from planning and command generation
candidate_contract.planning_and_control_vehicle: nominal vehicle with first three main-engine max_thrust_n multiplied by assumed_thrust_factor
candidate_contract.shared_implementation: reuse existing AvailableCapacityController and shared ReturnController without changing their guidance or threshold logic

comparison: same-condition original-plan records from step 1 are context; do not compare against scenario-encoded Rules scores or count them as new flights
interpretation: offline fixed-state capability-mismatch engineering screen; no AI success, continuous robustness, certified landing, sea clearance, water survival or real physical execution is established
order: assumed factors outer loop 100/80/60, actual factors inner loop 100/80/60; no result-dependent tuning, retry or extra cases

result_actions_ordered.next: retain every completed/partial record, report incomplete and stop; do not treat missing results as physical failure or begin AI trials
result_actions_ordered.when: budget, input/source mismatch, numerical error or invalid record prevents a complete matrix

result_actions_ordered.next: report the contradiction and diagnose saved records; do not retune or begin AI trials
result_actions_ordered.when: matched 80/80 or 60/60 cannot reproduce the prior candidate contact gate

result_actions_ordered.next: propose the capability-aware executor as a standard-procedure candidate for this tested grid; compare fuel/time tradeoffs before adoption, require separate broader qualification, and do not invent an AI switch for this fault
result_actions_ordered.when: all nine cells have valid contact records meeting every unchanged limit

result_actions_ordered.next: report discrete sensitivity to capability error; preregister a future symptom/uncertainty experiment where numerical estimates inform AI observation/procedure/resource decisions; do not infer a continuous uncertainty interval from these three factors
result_actions_ordered.when: matched 80/80 and 60/60 pass but at least one off-diagonal cell has a valid contact-limit failure

result_actions_ordered.next: report the full matrix as mixed evidence and stop; any additional strengths, estimator experiment or controller change requires a new protocol
result_actions_ordered.when: complete valid results fall outside the preceding cases

retention.cleanup: no Docker, unrelated files or unique prior flight records removed
retention.records: gzip JSON, SHA256, restore verification, frozen source/input/backend, execution claim and budgets; retain all outcomes

reuse.decision_before_execution: freeze reuse evidence and requested rows in the execution plan before any new propagation; if complete equivalence cannot be established, execute all nine rows within the same cap
required_bindings: unchanged shared physics/controller sources and backend
saved record SHA256 and gzip restore checks
all assumed-model vehicle/profile values exactly equal their former actual-capability inputs on the diagonal
reuse.requirement: bitwise equivalence of the complete controller/plant calculation after separating assumed and actual capability; matching final scalars or sparse saved samples alone is insufficient

stop_rules: no new propagation before user authorizes the additional stage
freeze protocol and executable source/backend/row/reuse plan before propagation
no threshold changes, automatic retries or new fault strengths
after stage 1.5 report, stop before stage 2
